license_consent_text: PASSION for Dermatology - Academic registration required at https://passionderm.github.io/ with academic email. Dataset provided for research purposes only.
notes: Metadata obtained from PASSION GitHub repository (label.csv and PASSION_split.csv)
1363 unique patient IDs based on filename prefixes.
Labels (4 disease categories) and Fitzpatrick skin types (1-6) available from GitHub metadata.
Patient-level train/val splits created (80/20, stratified by label and Fitzpatrick).
Train: 1090 subjects, 3182 images. Val: 273 subjects, 834 images.
No subject overlap between splits (patient-level separation verified).
Fitzpatrick IV-VI well represented in validation set (each ≥ 20 samples).
All PASSION conditions are benign inflammatory - mapped to 'benign' for 3-class triage evaluation.
option_chosen: Option B: PASSION used as external evaluation / fairness cohort
